candidates.explanation: Keep the checked-out connection eligible for release when an insufficient-stock request is rejected.

Rejected checkouts leak pool slots.

The proposed repair passed deterministic policy but failed sandbox verification. Normal insufficient-stock requests double-released their connection, causing pool capacity to exceed its configured maximum.
